feeds.title: MITCHELL KOCIAN Blog
feeds.description: Whether you plan on making Canmore your permanent residence, are looking for a weekend retreat, or a great investment opportunity, we have the experience, market knowledge, and strong negotiation skills to guide our clients effortlessly through each transaction. Read more about it in our blogs.

feeds.title: Richard Greaves Blog
feeds.description: Every year hundreds of new residents make Canmore their home. They fall in love with the small-town charm, pristine mountain air and relaxed yet active lifestyle. They feel healthier and their families are happier than ever before. Read more about all things Canmore, Banff, and the Bow Valley in our blog section.

feeds.title: City To Summit Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Our priority is to make my clients happy and ensure that they get the best service in Canmore! If you're looking for local real estate assistance, it would be my pleasure to act as your guide and confidant. Stay up to date on all the latest news about Canmore neighborhoods, the real estate market, and much more in my real estate blog.

feeds.title: Barry Nestransky Blog
feeds.description: Barry Nestransky is a top producing Realtor® with RE/MAX Alpine Realty and the owner and operator of real estate development and construction company. Barry's extensive experience in real estate development, investment, and construction, enables him to specialize in a wide variety of real estate markets.

feeds.title: Mountain Living Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Real Estate is not just a job, it is a passion and a lifestyle. Operating with a background in business and strategic marketing development equips me with a professional portfolio of skills that can be adapted to work with every style of client. Most crucially, it allows me to offer exceptional communication, negotiation, and marketing insight.

feeds.title: Christina Carrick Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Christina's specialties include digital marketing, luxury home sales, sustainable 'green' real estate, condo sales, and pre-construction sales and purchasing. She is passionate about the power of digital marketing and leverages the newest technology available to benefit her clients. Christina's resume over the past 14 years demonstrates her exceptional service and success in the real estate marketplace.

feeds.title: MacTeam Canmore Blog
feeds.description: The MacTeam Canmore Blog, managed by Kelly MacMillan is a real estate blog that provides updates on properties sold or listed by Kelly, a real estate agent with RE/MAX Alpine Realty in Canmore, Alberta, Canada.

feeds.title: Dan McGuire Realtor Blog
feeds.description: Dan McGuire is a licensed and registered Real Estate Associate & REALTOR®, as well as a member of the Canadian Real Estate Association, Alberta Real Estate Association, Calgary Real Estate Board, and Canmore Real Estate Brokers Group. Dan brings a wealth of knowledge from several years of success in corporate luxury sales & marketing right here in the Bow Valley.

feeds.title: Distinctive Homes Blog
feeds.description: Distinctive Homes is driven by an unwavering commitment to create beautiful, high quality, environmentally responsible, and affordable homes for our clients. We're truly passionate about homebuilding. Stay up to date on all the latest news and developments of our mountain living builds and luxury living in Canmore, Alberta.

feeds.title: Gary Bavis Blog
feeds.description: Real estate has always been in my blood. I grew up out east in New Brunswick. My dad always had a small business and built a number of homes. We moved quite a bit because of this. Specializing in second home sales and listings in Canmore, Alberta. Message me for my complete mount. There's something for everyone and I'm happy to have the local knowledge and lifestyle experience to really guide them.

feeds.title: Jessica Stoner
feeds.description: Jessica Stoner has been a real estate agent in Canmore for 24 years and has lived in the Bow Valley for the past 33 years. She enjoys the mountain lifestyle and is a passionate mountain biker. She enjoys all styles of skiing and yoga when not biking. She is passionate about real estate work, play and community in the Bow Valley.

feeds.title: Robin Tuck Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Robin works with RE/MAX Cascade Realty to cover all real estate in the Bow Valley. This includes Banff, Canmore, Exshaw, Dead Man's Flats and Lake Louise. We also cover Cochrane and Calgary for our clients. Investing isn't as tricky as it sounds, but there are a few nuances to the market. Get in touch to learn more about it!

feeds.title: Spring Creek Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in vacation rentals, mountain living, mountain life, mountain lifestyle, condos, vacation homes, etc. Spring Creek wows with stunning views and innovative energy efficiency practices. At the Heart of Canmore - We love Canmore, Alberta and want to share our love story with you. Your source for local events, profiles and area information.

feeds.title: Mountain Real Estate Magazine
feeds.description: Mountain Real Estate is the only dedicated real estate magazine for Banff, Canmore and surrounding areas. Find local properties for sale from local real estate agents who live and love the mountains. The magazine also has features about buying and selling in our unique market, as well as stories about the best aspects of mountain living. Get ready to buy into the dream!

feeds.title: Canmore Real Estate Group Blog
feeds.description: Our professional team invests every effort in providing you with the highest level of service possible when selling or searching for your new home or condo. Our goal is to efficiently serve our clients by providing the guidance you are seeking when faced with all of the various issues related to your real estate transaction.

feeds.title: RE/MAX Alpine Realty Blog
feeds.description: Search for real estate in Canmore or Banff, and find a professional real estate agent. Each month we provide insight into the real estate market. We shine a spotlight on tips and advice on how to sell your mountain home along with information about the local, regional and national real estate markets.

feeds.title: Jan Cerny MScEng Blog
feeds.description: A real estate professional, seasoned investment advisor, and former IT manager. Real Estate Associate with RE/MAX Alpine Realty in beautiful Canmore and Banff. We are implementing previous knowledge from private investments in real estate in residential real estate space. We built my business around the inner drive to educate and empower with expertise.

feeds.title: Canmore and Banff Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Combining the world's most prestigious real estate brand with the local market knowledge and specialized marketing expertise, we are the leading real estate sales and marketing company for Canada's and the world's most exceptional properties. Our commitment to our clients is to do more to market your home and to service your real estate needs than any other company.

feeds.title: Canmore Thomas Blog
feeds.description: Thomas Krause - CanmoreThomas - is a professional full-time realtor with RE/MAX Alpine Realty in Canmore. Thomas turned to the manufacturing industry as a career. For many years he served as a program /volunteer coordinator and Vice Chair on the board of the Canmore Canada Day association.
